main_text.p: tipotuerat. Pactū aūt quod subjectū est, quidā dicebāt ad fortis solutionē tantum pertinere, nō etiam ad usurarum; quæ priore parte simpliciter in stipulatione venissent: pa-ctūq; id tātum ad exceptionē prodesse. Et ideo non soluta pecunia statutis pensionibus, ex die stipulationis usuras deberi, atq; si id nominatim ef-fet expressum. Sed cū fortis petitio dilata fit, consequens est, ut etiā usurae ex eo tēpore quo morā fecit, accedāt. Et si ut ille putabat, ad exceptionē tātum prodesset pactum, quamuis sententia diversa obtinuerit, tamen usurarum

page.notes: The page number "39" is partly unclear at the top right; the last digit is marked [?]. The running head's middle words are not legible on the scan. The gathering mark "t 4" is taken as the signature and "obli-" as the catchword. A small stray stroke below the text is not printed matter and is left out. Spelling is kept as printed except u/v and i/j, long s is plain s, and the ct ligature is rendered as "ct". The printed hyphen in "pa-ctūq;" and "ef-fet" is kept.
